name: Cruzeiro (Brazil)
description: Thirteen horizontal stripes of light blue and white with a red canton bearing a white disc with a blue map of São Paulo state, surrounded by the five yellow stars of the Southern Cross.
history: Cruzeiro is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, named after the Southern Cross. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the flag was officially adopted by a decree of 19 November 1979 under Mayor Jorge Santiago; Flags of the World notes that it derives from the state flag, with the black stripes recoloured blue, the map of Brazil replaced by the map of the state and a fifth star added for Cruzeiro.
